oracle: the co-editor reads the replacement in place
what: Skip remote DOM delivery after initial shared-body adoption. The approver can claim, save and record the local acceptance, but the co-editor keeps the pre-accept text; its exact replacement oracle must fail. Returning before onRemote prevents a stale co-editor autosave from masking this directional fault.

target.case: A8.9 the version committed after an in-app accept holds the replacement once and passes REHASH, DECOR and BODYATTR; the accept reached a co-editor once

expect.message: the co-editor reads the replacement in place
